SYY.thesis_one_line: America's largest restaurant-food distributor is buying the cash-and-carry leader with mostly borrowed money; the price allows for that if regulators approve.
kill_criteria: FTC suit to block, or merger agreement terminated, before the target close of fiscal Q3 2027 (by 27 Mar 2027).
Consolidated net debt/adjusted EBITDA (earnings-release Net Debt table) above 4.5x at fiscal year-end June 2027, or not down at least 0.5x within 12 months of close.
US Foodservice local case volume growth below 1.0% in two consecutive quarters (Q4 FY26: +2.6%).
FY27 adjusted EPS growth guidance cut below the 9% low end, or actual FY27 adjusted EPS below $4.98 (FY26 $4.61 x 1.08).
JRD segment sales down year on year for two consecutive quarters after close (2025: +3.1%).
key_adverse_facts: $29.1B Jetro deal pending; FTC second request received 27 May 2026; $1.164B break fee.
Pro forma total debt about $34.4B, net debt/adj EBITDA about 5.0x (my arithmetic) vs 2.75x target; buybacks paused.
Pro forma GAAP EPS $2.83 vs $3.66 actual (8-K 0001104659-26-107510 Ex 99.3).
12.35M shares issued at $81.00 on 16 Sep 2026; new notes 5.45%-6.60% coupons.
Interim CFO; FY27 guidance is on a 53-week basis.
data_conflicts: d4 totalDebt $15.05B and FCF $1.91B include leases/gross capex; consolidated debt per release is $13.516B and company FCF $2.1B.
Management JRD 'free cash flow $1.9B' and combined '$5.5B' equal EBITDA less capex before tax and interest (my reading), not equity cash flow.
SYY.confidence_in_thesis: med: standalone business verified, outcome hinges on FTC and leverage path

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF implies 2.6%-6.0% 10-year FCF growth pro forma vs my 5% base.

SYY.scenario_basis: Standalone FY27E adj EPS $5.05, growth 3/7/10% to FY30E, exit NTM P/E 13/15.5/17x, dividends $2.20/yr; deal accretion excluded; bear includes FTC block and $1.164B fee.

SOLV.thesis_one_line: A former 3M medical-supplies and software business, cutting costs and splitting off health IT, whose reported profit is well ahead of its cash.
kill_criteria: Q3 2026 organic sales growth below -2% (reported about 5 Nov 2026), or FY26 organic growth guide cut below +2.5%.
Consolidated total debt less cash (10-Q debt note and balance sheet) above $5.5B (now $4.68B), or any further increase in the Bair Hugger accrual disclosed in a 10-Q.
FY27 adjusted EPS guidance midpoint below $7.00 (would mean under 5% growth ex the tariff refund).
H2 2026 adjusted operating margin below 21% (H1 26: 24.2%, including the refund and ERP timing; H1 25: 20.8%).
key_adverse_facts: Q2 26 adjusted EPS $2.55 included about $100M pre-tax IEEPA tariff refund and about $125M of pulled-forward sales (10-Q); Q3 will be hit.
FY26 EPS guide raised $0.50-$0.60 vs $6.60, about the size of the one-off refund.
FCF guide $200-300M vs adjusted net income about $1.24B; FY25 FCF was -$10M.
Bair Hugger litigation accrual raised in Q2 26 with no amount disclosed; PFAS responsibility post-spin.
$355M buybacks in H1 26 while H1 FCF was -$129M; cash down $475M.
data_conflicts: Triage net debt/EBITDA 4.3x uses Yahoo GAAP-basis EBITDA; consolidated net debt is $4.68B (debt $5,079M less cash $403M) and about 2.3x on my estimated adjusted EBITDA.
Triage described PFAS exposure as mostly retained by 3M; the 10-K says 3M indemnifies certain product claims through 2025 only.
SOLV.confidence_in_thesis: med: adverse facts are filing-verified; upside case depends on cash conversion not yet shown

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Price implies 5% FCF growth on a normalised $690M but 32% on guided FCF less SBC; evidenced cash flow is far below adjusted earnings.

SOLV.scenario_basis: FY26E underlying adj EPS $6.69 (guide mid $7.15 less $0.46 tariff refund), growth 0/6/10% to FY30E, exit NTM P/E 10/13/15x, no dividend.

CDW.thesis_one_line: The biggest US reseller of business computers, software and cloud services is priced for almost no growth while sales still grow about 10%.
kill_criteria: Non-GAAP operating margin below 7.5% in two consecutive quarters (Q2 26: 8.5%; H1 26: 8.2%).
Gross profit dollars down year on year in two consecutive quarters (Q2 26: +6.3%).
Consolidated net debt (company definition, release table) over 3.5x TTM non-GAAP operating income (now 2.7x, my calc).
FY26 adjusted FCF (company definition) below $700M (FY25 $1,085.5M; H1 26 $278.4M).
Sales growth below 3% in any quarter for two consecutive quarters (Q2 26: +10.0%).
key_adverse_facts: Gross margin down 70 bps in Q2 26 to 20.1% on hardware mix; S&A +8.6%; GAAP operating income only +2.0%.
H1 26 FCF $165.8M vs $393.7M; DSO 93 days vs 80 a year ago; inventory up 74% since Dec.
GAAP EPS flat for three years ($8.10, $7.97, $8.08).
$1.5B new notes at 5.7%-6.35% on 21 Sep 2026 vs $1.0B 2.67% notes due Dec 2026.
CFO retiring in 2027; no numeric guidance given.
data_conflicts: d4 TTM FCF yield 4.0% (TTM working-capital trough) vs FY25 FCF yield 6.4%.
d4 total debt $6.43B includes lease/inventory-financing items; consolidated debt per release is $5,817.0M.
CDW.confidence_in_thesis: med: cheap and cash-generative over a full year but profit growth lags sales

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF implies 3.1%-6.5% FCF growth depending on FCF base vs my 5.5% base.

CDW.scenario_basis: FY26E consensus non-GAAP EPS $10.96, growth 2/6/10% to FY30E, exit NTM P/E 10/12/13.5x, dividends $2.52/yr.
